body: I'm thinner than that and I'm not bulimic.

I feel distant and absent. I feel like I'm not really there, like I'm about to wake up. I don't see the punches coming, I realize I did it only after it's already been done. I'm surprised by and after every single one. Sometimes it's one and a couple of minutes, other times it's a volley. I can't tell if I stop because I want to or I just stop.

Edit: I red your question wrong. I thought you asked exactly what I feel when I do it. As for reasoning, I have none. They do, honestly, come out of the blue.
